lines: A phantom flower blooming on another's sleeve
I simply dropped indigo there
In a night that melts color flamboyantly, add a vermilion moon
Cutting through the wind as if tumbling, I grew stronger with every stumble
Hold it all close — the light, the pain, the anger, everything
If you weren't chosen, then choose
Voice, resound, to the far side of the night
Blurred by tears, carry all the way to that scenery so far away
What am I playing? Who do I want it to reach?
It's fine to stay uncertain, as it is
However dark the feelings
However long the struggle
Scatter with song, reverberation
A thousand nights dancing alone
When I tie the sash that cannot be retied
As if to outdo even the boldest colors, the scent of crimson is what moves the heart
Whatever painful times lie ahead
Rather than fine words, stand tall
Just follow every light of the dream I drew
You didn't come this far to run away, did you?
If you weren't chosen, then choose
Voice worn hoarse, like a flower burning
Once it lights up the darkness between
Turn even an answer too vague into a score
Like counting the nights and painting the morning
Make a vivid sound ring out
However deep the regret
However high the limit
Drown it out, reverberation
